tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Germanium (II) compounds are powerful reducing agents whereas lead (IV) compounds are strong oxidising agents even they belongs to same group (14), this is due to

options.text: More powerful inert pair effect in Pb than Ge
The ionisation energy of Pb < IE of Ge
Pb is more electronegative than Ge
The ionic radius of Ge<sup>2+</sup> and Ge<sup>4+</sup> are greater than Pb<sup>2+</sup> and Pb<sup>4+</sup>

solution.text:
Inert pair effect increases in 14th group as the atomic number increases.

On moving top to bottom on group 14

Z C 6 Si 1 4 Ge 3 2 Sn 5 0 Pb 8 2 ↓ • Atomic number increases • Inert pair effect increases
